countries.name: Japan
countries.bluf: Japan is in its biggest military build-up since 1945: 2% of GDP reached two years early, its first long-range counterstrike missiles fielded in 2026, all three services under one joint command, and ground forces shifting to the Southwest Islands.

countries.name: Poland
countries.bluf: Poland is building the largest land army in the EU, funded at a record ~4.8% of GDP, postured for homeland and forward defence of NATO's eastern flank and absorbing Western and South Korean kit at exceptional speed.
